body:
### Toxin Optimized ☣️
The Ultimate FPS Powerhouse for Every PC.

Are you tired of playing Minecraft like a slideshow? Toxin Optimized is a lightweight, high-performance modpack designed to squeeze every single frame out of your hardware. Whether you are playing on a high-end beast or a literal "rotting potato" laptop, Toxin Optimized delivers a smooth, buttery experience without changing the Vanilla feel you love.

Built for the community in Bangladesh (BD) and beyond, this pack is your replacement for OptiFine, providing better performance, faster loading times, and a toxic-free lag experience.

🚀 Why Choose Toxin Optimized?
Insane FPS Boost: Powered by the latest 2026 optimization engine (Sodium, Lithium, and more) to double or even triple your frame rate.

Potato Friendly: Specifically tuned for low-end PCs and laptops. If it can run Windows, it can run Toxin Optimized.

OptiFine Parity: Get all the features you miss—connected textures, zoom, and shaders support—without the slow performance of old-school mods.

Zero Bloat: We only include mods that actually help. No useless "fluff" to slow down your startup time.

BD Optimized: Built with love for the local community, ensuring stable performance for multiplayer and local servers.

🛠️ Key Features
World-Class Rendering: Ultra-fast chunk loading and smooth frame delivery.

Memory Fixes: Drastically reduced RAM usage so you can keep your browser open in the background.

Shader Ready: Comes pre-configured for Iris Shaders. Make your game look beautiful without killing your GPU.

Fast Boot: Get from the launcher to your world in seconds, not minutes.

📥 How to Install
Download the CurseForge or Modrinth App.

Search for "Toxin Optimized".

Hit Install and get ready to see Minecraft like never before.

Stop Lagging. Start Dominating.
Join the Toxin Optimized revolution today!
[Discord](https://dsc.gg/mrtoxin25)
